snippet.title: Grim Pulse - The First Blood | Devlog #001 (First Look - 18 Minutes of Uninterrupted Gameplay)
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4481130/Grim_Pulse_The_First_Blood/
Like, Subscribe, Comment

Want to support this development?
https://paypal.me/Prav2024
Join the Discord, you can find the link on the channel or below~
https://discord.gg/SWDmcuz5cX

Grim Pulse - The First Blood is an independent gothic action RPG currently in development.
This video is 18 minutes of uninterrupted 4K gameplay, recorded from opening the game through live play.
No commentary. No pacing.

What you'll see:

The main menu and loading sequences
Narrative- driven environmental design
Combat inspired by character action games
Voice-over systems and crowd behaviors
Visual effects and atmospheric systems
Quest-driven structure and world traversal

Grim Pulse is structured as a dream-state vision | A world shaped by memory, restraint, and consequence.
This devlog exists to show the work as it is, not to sell it.

If you are interested in observing development quietly, a small Discord exists.
Please see the Discord link on the video, and YouTube profile.

https://discord.gg/SWDmcuz5cX

Devlog #001 More will follow when there is something worth showing.
